question: How many calendar years passed from the year Chase Koch was appointed president of Koch Fertilizer to the year he became president of the newly founded Koch Disruptive Technologies?
why_needs_multiple: Cần hai mốc có năm xác định để tính khoảng cách; không trả lời được từ một mốc.
criterion: Chase Koch taking up a presidency or board seat at a Koch company

question: How many calendar years passed from the year Chase Koch joined the board of Koch Industries to the year he became president of the newly founded Koch Disruptive Technologies?
